question: Who among the following won the Tansen Samman 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satish Vyas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satish Vyas**__

 __
 
• India's **Satish Vyas plays the santoor**.
 
• His father is an **Indian classical singer named C. R. Vyas**.
 
• He's been a fantastic musician for more than **30 years**.
 
• He received the esteemed **Tansen Samman award in December 2020**.
 
• Around the globe, he has **given performances at well-known venues**.
 
• At the **Aga Khan Museum in Toronto, Canada**, he gave a performance for the **Raag-Mala Music Society of Toronto in 2019**.
 
• In **2003, the Padma Shri** award was given to him.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tansen Samman**__

 
 
• Every year in the month of** December, Behat village in the Gwalior district of Madhya Pradesh celebrates Tansen Samaroh **or Tansen Sangeet Samaroh.
 
• A** 4-day musical festival **is taking place.
 
• Here, **musicians and artists from all over the world come** to honour the **legendary Indian musical maestro Tansen**.
